# northflank_preview_blueprint (Data Source)

Looks up a preview blueprint in a project, by `id` or by `name`. Set exactly one of them. Useful for handing the blueprint's ID to a CI pipeline that starts runs through the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "northflank_preview_blueprint" "pr" {
  project_id = "my-application"
  name       = "PR Previews"
}

output "preview_blueprint_id" {
  value = data.northflank_preview_blueprint.pr.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the blueprint belongs to.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the blueprint. Set this to look it up by ID.
- `name` (String) Name of the blueprint. Set this to look it up by name.

### Read-Only

- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the blueprint's Git and webhook triggers are paused.
- `status` (String) Status of the blueprint's latest run.
